errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: The app hit a problem loading this screen. This is usually fixed by reloading.

billing.noProductsYet: No products yet — add some from Inventory.

voice.title: Voice Billing
voice.tapToStart: Tap the mic and say e.g. "idli 2 dosa 3"
voice.listening: Listening… keep going, tap to stop when done
voice.notSupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser. Try Chrome or Edge — or type the order below and it'll be parsed the same way.
voice.noMatchedItemsError: No matched items to add yet
voice.micPermissionDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow mic access in your browser settings and try again.
voice.languageNotSupportedTamil: This phone doesn't have Tamil voice input installed. Open Google app → Settings → Voice → Languages and add Tamil, or switch to English above and just speak the Tamil words normally (e.g. "rendu idli") — that works too.
voice.languageNotSupported: Voice input for this language isn't available on this device.
voice.networkError: No internet connection for voice recognition. You can type the order below instead.
voice.genericError: Voice recognition had a problem. You can type the order below instead.

cart.tapToAdd: Tap a product to add it here.
cart.billHeldToast: Bill held. Recall it anytime before checkout.
cart.recallConfirm: This will replace your current cart. Continue?

payment.saveFailedToast: Could not save the order. Please try again.
payment.addPhoneForWhatsAppToast: Add a customer phone number to share on WhatsApp.
payment.confirmAmountWithCustomer: Ask the customer to confirm the amount before paying
payment.noStaticQr: No static QR uploaded yet. Add one in Settings → Payment, or switch checkout to Dynamic QR.
payment.addUpiId: Add your UPI ID in Settings → Payment Settings to enable QR payments.
payment.upiCopyFailedToast: Could not copy — long-press the ID instead

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.noProductsFound: No products found. Add your first one.

productForm.voiceNameHint: Tap the mic and say the product name
productForm.voiceAliasesHint: Other ways staff say this item out loud, comma separated — in Tamil or English. Helps the mic on the Billing screen recognise it correctly.

reports.title: Reports
reports.noSales: No sales in this period yet.
reports.noCategoryData: No category data — items need a category assigned in Inventory.
reports.noCustomersYet: No repeat-identifiable customers yet — phone numbers are optional at checkout.

settings.title: Settings
settings.qrDynamic: Dynamic — auto-fills the exact bill amount (recommended)
settings.qrStatic: Static — a fixed QR image, customer types amount manually
settings.dynamicQrHint: Used to build the Dynamic QR — the customer scans and the exact bill amount is pre-filled, so there's no typing and no short-payment mistakes.
settings.staticQrImage: Static QR image (optional — from your bank/UPI app)
settings.staticQrHint: Only shown at checkout if "Static" is selected above. Useful as a backup if your UPI ID ever changes or you'd rather show your bank's official QR.
settings.printerBluetoothHint: Bluetooth thermal printers pair through your device's own Bluetooth settings first; once paired, the browser print dialog will list them like any other printer.
settings.languageHint: Changes text across the whole app immediately, on this device. Saved to your shop so it's remembered next time you sign in here too.
settings.backupHint: Backup exports your products, categories, customers, and orders as a JSON file. Restore only brings back products and categories — past orders are never overwritten, to keep your sales history accurate.
settings.restoreFailedToast: That file could not be read as a valid backup.

login.tagline: Sign in with Google to open your shop. Your Google account is your shop — first sign-in sets it up automatically.
login.signInFailedToast: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.footnote: Each Google account manages exactly one shop's billing, inventory, and reports.
